CGS @ YouTube: New YouTube channel

Today, we have set up a YouTube channel to demonstrate and present the technologies and projects. First contribution to the channel is a video showing the potentials of “Bended 3D Maps” (Multi-Perspective Views for Maps). You can find the YoutTube channel of the HPI Computer Graphics Systems group at the following url: www.youtube.com/hpicgs.
